fato_historico: 1966: A group of red guards at Experimental High in Beijing, including Deng Rong and Liu Pingping, daughters of Deng Xiaoping and Liu Shaoqi respectively, beat the deputy vice principal, Bian Zhongyun, to death with sticks after accusing her of counter-revolutionary revisionism, producing one of the first fatalities of the Cultural Revolution.
energia_do_dia: The stars suggest that today might be a powerful moment to reflect on the legacy of our actions. Just as the winds of history often shift suddenly, your own energy may be turbulent. Consider channeling your intensity into compassion rather than conflict, transforming old tensions into seeds of growth and personal evolution.
frase_do_dia: True strength is found in the grace we show to others every day.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of cosmic energy and personal balance.
conselho: Choose patience over impulsive reactions to maintain your radiant inner peace.
